title: Illustration Range
slide_intent: Match illustration complexity to the amount of space and attention available. An isolated object can identify something quickly; a larger scene gives someone more to explore.
strategic_value: Instacart can use both the efficient Shop and expressive Savor sides of its identity while retaining a recognizable drawing style.
demonstration: Three specimen cards progress from small icon illustrations to a spot illustration of a hand pressing a button and a hero composition of goods. An arrow labels the continuum from Efficient to Savor.
practical_value: Choose an icon illustration for a small cue, a spot for a single action and a hero for a larger story with several elements.

content_islands.name: Range introduction
content_islands.spec: Set the heading and brief in the left column. Explain that detail increases across the chart.

content_islands.name: Three specimens
content_islands.spec: Give Icon, Spot and Hero Illustrations equal-width cream cards. Increase the number and interaction of objects from left to right.

content_islands.name: Continuum
content_islands.spec: Run one thin arrow below all three examples. Label its ends Efficient and Savor.
